correctness.rationale: The domain is all h>=1 with X=16^h, B=4^h, q=2^h; n ranges are integer half-open and the palindrome counts exclude zero in both bases. Reconstructed each boundary count using base-b length formulas, and the first-region digit-pair reversal, two- versus one-event middle blocks, and the last-region base-four bit-swap involution. Its first-nonzero-signed-digit domination gives T_h=2*16^(h-1)+2*T_(h-1) and T_h=(B^2-q)/7. The four interval win/loss/tie formulas sum to the displayed shell totals, with P+N+Z=15B^2. Summing geometric shells gives distinct initial-segment positive proportions 13/280,3/35,3/140. Independently counted every integer and palindrome event on all h=1..4 shells and reproduced (12,94,134),(179,1665,1996),(2853,27235,31352),(45641,438087,499312). The finite check corroborates but does not prove unbounded h.
residual_risks: No global liminf/limsup of density is claimed; arguments require all four boundary conventions exactly.
